name: Run scripts
description: Runs your own executables from a scripts folder when Aurral sends a notification or files a downloaded track.

settings.label: Scripts folder
settings.help: The folder that holds your scripts, for example /scripts. Only files directly inside it run. Mount it read-only.

settings.label: Discover updated
settings.help: Script file names to run, separated by commas. Leave blank to run nothing.

settings.label: Track added
settings.help: Runs once for each track Aurral files in the Library, including flow tracks.

settings.label: Timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long a script may run before it and everything it started are stopped. Default 60, up to 3600.

settings.label: Test runs the scripts
settings.help: When on, Test also runs every script listed above once, with the event scriptTest and sample values.
